answer: To trade, each newcomer must cross a reputation bridge carrying two signed work credentials from independent economies, each 90 days old and worth 100 points. Forging one means corrupting a foreign ledger, so planting an orchard of 1,000 fakes demands 2,000 forgeries. A failed check freezes the applicant 30 days; the ridge between cheap talk and verified history is that price: genuine newcomers cross once, attackers pay per fake.
